meta.execution: Signal at T close, execution at T+1 open with slippage; final close forced at interval end.
meta.selection_rule: 2026YTD is used only as final validation; ranking uses 2021-2025 training metrics and train trend-capture penalties.

split_adjustment.handling: Cloud OHLC series appears continuously adjusted; no second split adjustment was applied.

current_app.formula: Entry: NVDA close breaks prior 15d high/low. Filters: NVDA close above/below EMA80; NVDA ROC80 > -8%; QQQ ROC60 > 2%; NVDA-QQQ ROC80 > 0%; ATR50% <= 6.0%. Exit: SMA40; 57d opposite channel; fixed stop 20%; trailing stop 24%; take profit 20%; ATR stop 2.0x; ATR trailing stop 4.0x; max hold 20d.

closest.formula: Entry: NVDA SMA7 crosses SMA117; short side symmetric. Filters: NVDA close above/below EMA80; NVDA ROC40 > 0%; QQQ EMA200 filter; NVDA-QQQ ROC80 > -6%. Exit: raw reverse MA cross; EMA150; trailing stop 24%; take profit 16%.

Entry: NVDA close breaks prior 15d high/low. Filters: NVDA close above/below EMA80; NVDA ROC80 > -8%; QQQ ROC60 > 2%; NVDA-QQQ ROC80 > 0%; ATR50% <= 6.0%. Exit: SMA40; 57d opposite channel; fixed stop 20%; trailing stop 24%; take profit 20%; ATR stop 2.0x; ATR trailing stop 4.0x; max hold 20d.

Regime: uptrend when NVDA close > EMA100, slope60 >= 0.001, ROC20 >= 0%, ADX14 >= 30; range when ADX14 <= 25 and slope/ROC are muted; downtrend when close < SMA200 with negative slope/ROC. Uptrend long entry: regime; exit by SMA40 or ATR30 trailing 4.0x / stop 1.2x / max hold 180d / no fixed trend take-profit. Range entry: none; range take-profit 16%, stop 18%, max hold 60d. Shorts enabled in downtrend.
